name: 08028 · Glassboro, NJ
findings: ZIP 08028 (Glassboro) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08028 (Glassboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08028 (Glassboro) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).
